recommendations.detail: Re-enable targeting for 'Metro South' (Ages 25-55) as identified in the top-performing ad set. This segment showed a competitive cost-per-message of 32.54, which is significantly lower than the July average of 78.34.

recommendations.title: Set Daily Budget for Consistent Pacing
recommendations.detail: Establish a consistent daily budget based on historical performance (approx. 200-250/day) to avoid the stop-start delivery patterns seen in late July, which likely contributed to poor auction stability.
